column1: # The names in the web Phiogy's files (puikit: app/phiogy/public/data):
# what the code calls each, and how the files spell it. A name that
# changes there changes here, never in the code.
# The app's own file: the app, the room it starts on, the file of its
# rooms and people, the file of every host, the hosts shown in its
# rail, and the ids of the hosts of that file the person joined.
# A host, a heading under it and a room: its id, what it is called, its
# icon, what it holds, and whether it is a heading.
# A host's numbers: how many members, how many of them are here.
# The rooms' file: the rooms by id, the people, and of a room its
# topic, its kind (and the kind that is a voice room), and its people;
# How many of a room's messages are not read, and what was said in it:
# who said it, the day and the hour, the words, the pictures, what it
# was marked with (an icon, and how many), which message it answers,
# The pages of the app's file, and what a page is made of. A block
# that shows a room is of this kind and variant.
# The people: who the person using the app is among them; of each
# their handle, what they are there, what they say of themself,
# whether they are about (a word, and in words), since when, their
# tags, how many they are linked to, the picture over their profile;
# the spaces by name with who is in each; a room's space; and the file
# of who is linked to whom, with its two lists.
# What the person writes: how the id of a message of theirs begins
# (the moment follows), and the mark a like is.
# Around the rooms. In the app's document: the group of the rail that
# lists direct conversations, and the shops' index. In the hosts'
# file: what a new host starts from, each with its rooms and the
# heading each stands under. In the rooms' file: how the person's
# friends start. In a host the person made: its group of the rail and
# its rooms, with the icons of a text room and of a voice room.
# The shops' index: the folder of the shops' own files, the ones open
# from the start, every shop, and of a shop a line about it and how
# A shop's own file: its menu, its products and its landing; of a
# page of the menu the places of its products; of a product what it
# is called, its price as a number, a line about it, its cell of a
# sheet, whether Phiora prices it, whether it can be worn, and its own
# page with its views, what is said of it and its facts.
# A picture the person posts from this disk: how its key begins (the
# file's path follows, with strokes that lean forward), and the
# endings of the files that are pictures.
# Faces and marks: the sheet all faces share (its file, and how many
# faces it has across), a person's own sheet and the number of their
# face on it, the number of a place's mark on its sheet, and the person
# The fact of a thing that is its colour, as the site calls it: the
# same thing in its other colours is found by it.
